Thanks again for applying to the Platform Engineer role — I reviewed your profile and would love to set up a brief phone screen to learn more about your experience with inference runtimes and deployment orchestration. We usually keep this to ~20 minutes, but if you'd prefer 25m that's fine.

I know time zones can be tricky; you mentioned you're in London (BST). Could you do one of the following options? I've attached an .ics for the first option if that's easiest.

- Option A: Mon Apr 19 18:30–18:50 BST (20m) — ideal for our London-based interviewer
- Option B: Mon Apr 19 20:00–20:25 BST (25m) — if you prefer a slightly longer slot
- Backup: Tue Apr 20 08:00–08:20 BST (20m) — morning window if evenings don't work

If none of these suit, tell me two 30-minute windows that work in the next 3 business days and I will coordinate. Also, if there's a calendar you prefer (Outlook/Google) I can send directly.

Pre-call checklist: if you can complete this short pre-screen form it helps our hiring manager (link below) — it takes ~3 mins.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
